string.text: Anomalous Nozzle: NPCs — 10% class I–III, 5% class IV
Anomalous Barrel: mutant artifacts; chance depends on species
This weapon already has a unique upgrade installed.

%c[255,185,135,220]Unique anomalous upgrades%c[255,216,186,140]
The Keeper gives an Anomalous Nozzle for the next 14 Life Before the Accident notes, and an Anomalous Barrel for the final 20. The first 10 notes give 5 scanners.
A unique kit uses one of the three shared field slots. Repeated installation and combining both unique kits are forbidden. Dismantling always returns the unique kit, regardless of installation order, alongside the last non-unique upgrade and normal materials.
The player must kill the target while holding the upgraded weapon. This also applies after throwing a grenade. A weapon in the backpack gives no bonus.
Nozzle: NPCs, including zombified stalkers — 10% class I–III and 5% class IV.
Barrel — class I–III / class IV chances:
Tushkano: 1% / 0.5%.
Blind dog: 3% / 1.5%.
Flesh: 5% / 2.5%.
Pseudodog: 8% / 4%.
Boar, snork: 10% / 5%.
Bloodsucker, burer, controller, poltergeist, psy-dog: 15% / 7.5%.
Chimera: 20% / 10%.
Pseudogiant: 25% / 12.5%.
Variants inherit their species profile; unknown real mutants use 10% / 5%. Phantoms and illusions give no rewards.
The category chances add up; each target gives at most one bonus artifact. Within class I–III, the three classes are equally likely, followed by an equal choice among that class’s natural artifacts. Cooking results are excluded.
The artifact appears inside the corpse after ordinary loot processing. For disappearing bodies, it is placed on the ground near the target. The drop, class and item are tied to the target; reloading and changing kill order cannot change them.
